name: 马可波罗
current_thesis: 马可波罗是建筑陶瓷龙头，品牌、经销网络、现金流和资产负债表质量优于多数同业；但地产后周期需求仍在收缩，2026Q1收入利润继续下滑，当前14.33元缺少足够安全边际，暂列watch，等待11.5元以下或半年报验证毛利率、应收和现金流韧性后再考虑小仓买入。

position_plan.reason: 2026-07-10 price 14.33 CNY is within fair value range but above the preferred buy zone, while revenue and profit are still declining.
A small tracking position is acceptable only when price approaches the lower half of fair value and cash collection remains healthy.
A larger but still non-core position requires both valuation discount and evidence that the brand/channel moat is holding through the property downcycle.

price_triggers.reason: Review for first tracking buy if receivables, inventory and gross margin have not deteriorated.
Enter preferred buy zone; reassess whether margin of safety is sufficient for a 1%-3% small position.
Above the fair value range upper half; reduce unless earnings recovery has been confirmed.

review_triggers.reason: Review after 2026 interim report for revenue decline, gross margin, operating cash flow, receivables and inventory.
Review after 2026 third-quarter report for whether Q1 weakness has narrowed and whether valuation assumptions still hold.
